abort.two_factor_expired: The verification session ended. Start again to get a new code.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the portal
error.invalid_code: The verification code is incorrect or has expired

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the portal again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal session for {username} has ended or the password was rejected. Submit to log in again; if your account uses email verification, the portal sends you a new code. Leave the password empty to keep the saved one.

data_description.username: The username (usually your email address) you use on the portal.

user.description: Log in with the account you use on the EVC-net portal.
